Member Advocacy

Complaint Resolution

Northern Birch is committed to resolving member concerns fairly and promptly. Here is our complaint resolution process.

1

Contact Your Branch

Start by speaking with a staff member at your branch or calling us at 416-465-4659. Most concerns can be resolved at this level. Our team is trained to listen, investigate, and find solutions.

2

Escalate to Management

If you're not satisfied with the branch resolution, ask to speak with the Branch Manager or contact our CEO, Anita Saar, at asaar@northernbirchcu.com. Management will review your concern and respond within 10 business days.

3

Contact Our Ombudsperson

If the matter remains unresolved, you may contact the Ombudsman for Banking Services and Investments (OBSI) -- an independent organization that investigates complaints about financial services providers in Canada. OBSI services are free to consumers.

External Resolution Bodies

Ombudsman for Banking Services and Investments (OBSI)
Independent, free dispute resolution for banking and investment complaints.
1-888-451-4519 | www.obsi.ca
Financial Services Regulatory Authority of Ontario (FSRA)
Ontario's financial services regulator. Handles complaints about credit unions.
416-250-7250 | www.fsrao.ca
Financial Consumer Agency of Canada (FCAC)
Federal agency protecting consumers of financial products and services.
1-866-461-3222 | www.canada.ca/fcac
Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada
Handles privacy complaints under PIPEDA.
1-800-282-1376 | www.priv.gc.ca

FSRA INSURED

Eligible deposits at Northern Birch Credit Union are insured by the Financial Services Regulatory Authority of Ontario (FSRA). Registered account deposits have unlimited coverage. Other eligible deposits are insured up to $250,000 per depositor. Insurance products are not deposits and are not insured by FSRA.

Northern Birch Credit Union Limited. Member of Central 1 Credit Union. Regulated by FSRA.Insurance distributed on behalf of The Personal Insurance Company, CUMIS/Co-operators, and Manulife Financial.
